item.text: {"claim_id":"C020","obligation_id":"C020-B-1","contract":"CONDITIONAL_LICENSE","subject":"Agreement between usual and standardized readings on elevated package temperature would weaken measurement differences as the sole explanation.","verdict":"CONDITIONAL","unresolved_conditions":["The standardized measurement must provide a sufficiently reliable reference, with shared measurement errors assessed so that agreement is diagnostically meaningful.","Agreement and elevation must be distinguishable within the measurements' uncertainty."],"rationale":"The mechanism licenses weakening an explanation when evidence meaningfully conflicts with it. Comparable readings agreeing on elevation could weaken a measurement-only explanation, but temporal alignment, placement and comparability alone do not establish accuracy: shared error could produce the same agreement. The relation is therefore licensed subject to the unresolved reliability conditions, without asserting that agreement has occurred or locating a warming stage.","packet_id":"H7-T01-1","evidence_used":[{"source_id":"S003"},{"source_id":"S004"},{"source_id":"S005"},{"source_id":"P021"},{"source_id":"P022"}]}
